recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-40303 unless maintainers separately decide to retire or refresh source/fhirpath.md or change how the external FHIRPath usage page is maintained.
issue_request: FHIR-40303 was an Applied FHIR-I change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It reported that the FHIRPath page incorrectly claimed FHIRPath was used in SMART on FHIR CDS Hooks prefetch templates while that support was only in an outstanding CDS Hooks PR, and the accepted resolution was to maintain inverse usage examples on a Confluence page and link there from core.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3797, specifically commit d624d31444c9f4eb79f3ff3a85c4b62211060562, replaced the direct CDS Hooks prefetch sentence in source/fhirpath.html with a link to the FHIRPath Usage and Extensions Confluence page. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-40303 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/fhirpath.html is listed in publish.ini and currently lists core FHIRPath usages before pointing to the external Confluence page for other usage patterns and extensions. FHIR-I 2024-12-09 minutes record the same rationale and 6-0-1 Persuasive with Modification motion. The external Confluence page exists and lists CDS Hooks context among externally maintained examples. source/fhirpath.md still has old CDS Hooks wording, but no build/reference search found a current use of that Markdown file.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the Jira resolution, and editing the unreferenced Markdown file would not change the current specification output.
